location: Row [c842]; section introduction: "These 27 papers randomize people to generative-AI assistance and score the output".
claim: The report classifies c842 as small (report-data.json status_by_cid.c842), treating the output criterion as established.
problem: Supported status: needs clarification (clarify). The form explicitly leaves the output criterion unclear: the creativity ratings are participants' own ratings of AI-generated questions, while the proposed fluency measure counts questions generated by the agent. Whether that count qualifies as participant creative output has not been resolved. A sample below 50 does not resolve this additional eligibility uncertainty.
